titles.title: How to Escape the Sultan's Clutches

description:
Just when Caleana is about to be sold off as a slave in a foreign land, she takes a man hostage to bargain for her freedom. Little does she know, she has just put a blade to the throat of Erhan, the country’s new sultan. Amused by her bold stunt, Erhan decides to bring Caleana into his harem solely to make her his spy. But with her seductive looks and many talents, topped with a mysterious power to have dreams about the future, Caleana will prove she has much more worth than that of the sultan’s woman.
